1971-porsche-916.title: Porsche 916 Concept (1971) - Stuttcars
1971-porsche-916.summary: After a highly modified 914 finished sixth overall at Le Mans in 1970, Ferdinand Piëch saw potential for a higher-performance, luxurious version that could be registered for highway use, and pursued the idea of what would become the Porsche 916.

1971-porsche-916.title: Porsche 916: 11 Prototypes, Specs and 210 PS - renndriver.com
1971-porsche-916.summary: The Porsche 916 was a fixed-roof, higher-performance development of the 914/6, built as a small prototype series rather than a regular production model. Porsche’s own account puts the total at eleven cars, built in 1971 and 1972 before the project was cancelled.

1971-porsche-916.title: The Fascinating History of the Porsche 916 - Did You Know Cars
1971-porsche-916.summary: The Porsche 916 was introduced by the company at the Paris Auto Salon in 1971. The several has several unique features, including a sleeker appearance, flared fenders, a steel roof (Porsche is known for utilizing Targa top in their cars), and 7-inch wide Fuch five-spoke wheels.

1971-porsche-916.title: Porsche 916 - Home
1971-porsche-916.summary: Fully restored car converted to a 916. This beautiful car looks like new inside and out. This car won second place in the local Porsche auto show against many competitors. With an added stiffing kit this car turns like a go cart. With Lithium Ion Phosphate batteries, it will run on pennies a mile.

1971-porsche-916.title: The Hen’s Tooth | Issue 300 | Excellence | The Magazine About Porsche
1971-porsche-916.summary: Only 11 were constructed and they remain as rare as proverbial hens’ teeth. Still, they were perhaps among the most exciting road cars ever to emerge from the fabled automaker. All were development prototypes, as the 916 never made it into production.

1971-porsche-916.title: History of Porsche Cars - Hemmings
1971-porsche-916.summary: The 916 was scheduled to debut at the 1971 Paris Auto Salon in October, but, two weeks before the show, Porsche killed the 916 project and halted production of the car.

1971-porsche-916.title: Porsche Porsche 916 « Pyritz Classics GmbH In der Klassikstadt
1971-porsche-916.summary: Beschreibung Eins von 11 gebauten Exemplaren des Porsche 916. Eine Sportversion des Porsche 914/6 mit dem 2,7 Liter Motor des 911 und 190 PS. Offiziell gab es den Porsche 916 nie, doch Eingeweihte kannten dieses Modell schon seit 1972.

1971-porsche-916.title: Porsche 916 for sale - Vehicle Sales - DK Engineering
1971-porsche-916.summary: Planned for the 1972 model year, the Porsche 916 program was cancelled after eleven prototypes with aerodynamic front and rear bumpers and either the 2.4 engine from the 911S, or the 2.7 from the Carrera.

1971-porsche-916.title: Porsche Of The Day: 1971 Porsche 916 - Stuttcars
1971-porsche-916.summary: The 916 is Porsche’s rarest model is in fact one of the rarest vehicles in the world today. Produced in 1971, only 11 cars of this magnificent model were made and they were all prototypes.
